Comity Inc. | Hybrid (NY, Chicago, or Bay Area) | Full-time:

* Platform Engineering Manager * Infrastructure Finance Lead * Growth Lead

Comity is on a mission to improve the reliability, transparency, and efficiency of our energy systems, fostering a future with sustainable and abundant energy. To accomplish our aims, we’re leveraging state of the art statistical learning and convex optimization methods (AI) to build the financial trust layer for the electric age.

We envision energy systems that are efficient, autonomous, resilient, and electrified.

You can read the full JD and apply here: https://jobs.ashbyhq.com/comity
